step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram displays a real-time ad prediction and analytics system. 1. Ad Script (running on the user browser) calls the Decision Lambda worker to execute the head of a neural network for fast predictions (~100k per minute). 2. Ad Script interacts directly with DynamoDB for fast prediction context/data. 3. Ad interaction events are sent from Ad Script to SQS, which buffers them before storing them into S3 for business analytics and network re-training. 4. EKS enriches page, placement, and location contextual metadata into embeddings, storing them in DynamoDB. 5. DynamoDB updates/dimension data are also dumped into the S3 Data Lake.

nodes.name: DynamoDB

nodes.name: S3 Data Lake
nodes.notes: Stores interaction logs and enriched dimension data for business analytics and neural network training.
